questions.q: "Is he an American?" "No, he is ____ European."
questions.zh: 「他是美國人嗎？」「不，他是歐洲人。」
questions.explain: European [ju] 為子音發音開頭，故需用「a」。

questions.q: I want to ask you a question, and I want ____.
questions.zh: 我想問你一個問題，並且我要的是實話。
questions.explain:
① 後半句原為：..., and I want the truth of the question.
② 名詞後有形容詞片語或子句限制時，一般要用 the 置於名詞前。

questions.q: The workers are paid ____.
questions.zh: 工人按週計酬。
questions.explain: by the ＋ 計量單位（pound, week...）（以…計算）。

questions.q: ____ is a very fashionable place in Beijing.
questions.zh: 北海公園在北京市是很受歡迎的地方。
questions.explain: Beihai Park 是專有名詞，不須加冠詞。

questions.q: Mr. Lee is ____ one-eyed man you mentioned.
questions.zh: 李先生是你提到的那個獨眼龍。
questions.explain: one-eyed man 之後有子句 you mentioned 修飾，應加 the。

questions.q: He is so honest ____ that we all like him.
questions.zh: 他是如此誠實的孩子，所以我們都喜歡他。
questions.explain: so ＋ 形容詞 ＋ a(n) ＋ 名詞。

questions.q: What kind of ____ do you want?
questions.zh: 你想要哪種書？
questions.explain: what kind/sort of ＋ 單數名詞 ⇒ 名詞前不加冠詞。

questions.q: They are playing ____.
questions.zh: 他們正在打籃球。
questions.explain: play ＋ 球類運動 ⇒ 不加冠詞。

questions.q: She is playing ____.
questions.zh: 她正在彈鋼琴。
questions.explain: play the ＋ 樂器名稱。

questions.q: I have never seen ____ large apple before.
questions.zh: 我以前從未看過這麼大的蘋果。
questions.explain: such a/an ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞（如此…）。

questions.q: Birds of ____ feather flock together.
questions.zh: 物以類聚。
questions.explain: a ＝ the same（同一的；相同的）。

questions.q: The old often ____ the young good ____.
questions.zh: 老年人常給予年輕人忠告。
questions.explain:
① The old ＝ Old people（老年人，表複數）。
② advice（忠告）為不可數名詞。

questions.q: This is ____ interesting story I have ever heard.
questions.zh: 這是我所聽過的故事中最有趣的。
questions.explain: 最高級 ＋〔(that) I have ever heard〕（…中最…）。

questions.q: ____ fruit I bought yesterday spoiled.
questions.zh: 昨天我買的水果有些已經壞了。
questions.explain: 有關係子句修飾名詞時，應加上定冠詞 the，表示限定：the ＋ 名詞 ＋〔who/which ＋ (S) ＋ V...〕。

questions.q: ____ tourists come from Beijing, P. R. C.
questions.zh: 大部分的觀光客來自中華人民共和國的北京。
questions.explain: most ＋ 名詞 ＝ most of the ＋ 名詞（大部分）。

questions.q: ____ you study, ____ knowledge you can get.
questions.zh: 書讀得越多，知識越豐富。
questions.explain: The ＋ 比較級…，the ＋ 比較級…（愈…愈…）。

questions.q: ____ poet and ____ novelist are good friends.
questions.zh: 這位詩人與這位小說家是好朋友。
questions.explain:
The ＋ 名詞 and the ＋ 名詞 ⇒ 指不同兩人。
The ＋ 名詞 and 名詞 ⇒ 指一人兼兩職。

questions.q: ____ seem to be natural enemies.
questions.zh: 狗跟貓似乎是天生的敵人。
questions.explain:
表示總稱用法，用單數或複數均可，但需對稱：
A dog and a cat...
The dog and the cat...
Dogs and cats...

questions.q: This is ____ opportunity to be lost.
questions.zh: 勿失良機。
questions.explain:
① so ＋ 形 ＋ a(n) ＋ 名詞 ＋ that...（如此…以致…）
as ＋ 形 ＋ a(n) ＋ 名詞 ＋ as...（和…一樣…）
too ＋ 形 ＋ a(n) ＋ 名詞 ＋ to...（太…而不能…）
② such ＋ a(n) ＋ 形 ＋ 名詞 ＋ that...（如此…以致…）。本題為 too... to... 結構。

questions.q: You like to play ____ guitar while I like to play ____ baseball.
questions.zh: 你喜歡彈吉他而我喜歡打棒球。
questions.explain: 樂器名稱應加 the，運動名稱不需加 the。

questions.q: We can't drink ____ which is not clean.
questions.zh: 我們不能喝不乾淨的水。
questions.explain: 參閱第14題說明。water 後面有關係子句 which is not clean 限定，故加定冠詞 the。

questions.q: This is ____ book that I lost the other day.
questions.zh: 這就是我前幾天遺失的書。
questions.explain:
the same ＋ N ＋ that（和…一樣）⇒ 同一物。
the same ＋ N ＋ as...（和…一樣）⇒ 不同一物。

questions.q: We all know that ____ gold is a valuable metal.
questions.zh: 我們都知道黃金是有價值的金屬。
questions.explain: 物質名詞，不加冠詞，若表示限定時，常加 the。

questions.q: Albert Einstein, an ____ physicist, died in 1955.
questions.zh: 愛因斯坦是著名的物理學家，於1955年去世。
questions.explain:
a ＋ 子音發音字母開頭（famous, prominent, distinguished...）
an ＋ 母音發音字母開頭（outstanding...）。

questions.q: It is ____ to go fishing or to go swimming.
questions.zh: 去釣魚或游泳很有趣。
questions.explain:
① fun（樂趣）為抽象名詞，沒有複數，不加冠詞。
② funny（可笑的），意思不合。

questions.q: A cow is ____ as a horse.
questions.zh: 牛是與馬一樣的強壯動物。
questions.explain: as ＋ 形容詞 ＋ a(an) ＋ 名詞 ＋ as（和…一樣）。

questions.q: ____ twenty-four can be divided by 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 12.
questions.explain: 抽象名詞通常不加冠詞，但若為特定時需加冠詞。

questions.q: ____ of this house has been removed by the servant.
questions.zh: 這幢房子的家具已被僕人搬走了。
questions.explain: furniture（家具）為不可數名詞，原不置冠詞，但本句是限定用法，其後有形容詞片語（of the house）限定，故前置 the。

questions.q: John likes to keep track, in a general sort of ____, of all new developments in the natural science.
questions.zh: 約翰喜歡對自然科學中所有新的發展，有一些大致的了解。
questions.explain: a sort of ＋ 單數名詞 ⇒ 名詞前不加冠詞。

questions.q: ____ that can endure uncomplainingly a long period of suffering is perhaps the noblest.
questions.zh: 能毫無怨言地長期忍受痛苦的勇氣，也許是最高貴的。
questions.explain: courage 雖為抽象名詞，但後有關係子句限定，故前置 the。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依據中文提示，填入適當的英文字詞

questions.q:
他所住的公寓是按月租的。
The ____ he lives in is rent ____ ____.
questions.zh: 他所住的公寓是按月租的。
questions.explain: by the ＋（時間／距離／重量…）之名詞（以…計算）。

questions.q:
我們用電話跟朋友聯絡。
We get in ____ our friends ____ ____.
questions.zh: 我們用電話跟朋友聯絡。
questions.explain: by telephone ＝ on the telephone ＝ over the telephone ＝ through telephone（用電話）。

questions.q:
富有的人未必比窮人快樂。
____ rich are not ____ happier than ____ poor.
questions.zh: 富有的人未必比窮人快樂。
questions.explain:
① The rich（富有的人）；The poor（窮苦的人）。
② not always ＝ not necessarily（未必；不見得）。

questions.q:
日出於東而沒於西。
____ sun rises in ____ east and sets in ____ west.
questions.zh: 日出於東而沒於西。
questions.explain:
① 獨一無二的東西之前，應加定冠詞 the。
② 東西南北等方向之前，應加定冠詞 the。

questions.q:
有句格言說，「誠實為上策。」
A ____ goes, “____ is ____ best policy.”
questions.zh: 有句格言說，「誠實為上策。」
questions.explain: 抽象名詞前，不加 the；若表示特定，則加上 the。例：The honesty of the boy is beyond doubt.（這孩子的誠實是無可置疑的。）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 王先生一家人住在公園旁的一棟公寓裡。
questions.answer: The Wangs live in an apartment near the park.
questions.zh: 王先生一家人住在公園旁的一棟公寓裡。
questions.explain: The Wangs 指王家的所有家人。

questions.q: 由於家貧他們只得按月租用這間房子。
questions.hint: 按月租用：rent... by the month
answer: Out of poverty, they rent the house by the month.
Because of their poverty, they rent the house by the month.
As they are poor, they rent the house by the month.
questions.zh: 由於家貧他們只得按月租用這間房子。
questions.explain: Out of poverty 亦可用 Because of their poverty 或 As they are poor 等。

questions.q: 王先生白天騎腳踏車到市場賣些新鮮水果。
questions.hint: 騎腳踏車到市場：go to market by bicycle
answer: By day Mr. Wang goes to the market by bicycle to sell some fresh fruit.
In the daytime Mr. Wang goes to the market by bicycle to sell some fresh fruit.
During the day Mr. Wang goes to the market by bicycle to sell some fresh fruit.
questions.zh: 王先生白天騎腳踏車到市場賣些新鮮水果。
questions.explain: By day 亦可用 In the daytime 或 During the day。

questions.q: 他晚上靠打零工賺些外快以便養家活口。
questions.hint: 打零工：do some odd jobs；養家活口：support his family
questions.answer: By night, he makes some extra income by doing some odd jobs in order to support his family.
questions.zh: 他晚上靠打零工賺些外快以便養家活口。
questions.explain:
① make some extra income（賺取外快）。
② by ＝ by means of（藉…方式；以…方法）。

questions.q: 像王先生這樣認真工作的人早晚定會成功的。
questions.hint: 認真工作：work hard/diligently；早晚：sooner or later
questions.answer: Such a hard worker as Mr. Wang is sure to succeed sooner or later.
questions.zh: 像王先生這樣認真工作的人早晚定會成功的。
questions.explain: such ＋ a(n) ＋ 形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ as...（像…這樣的人）。

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並選出空格內最適當的答案：

There are many __1.__ entertainment for children today--books, movies, games, and sports are only __2.__ the possibilities. Television is __3.__ newest kinds of entertainment. It __4.__ for about forty years, and __5.__ a great influence on children. Some people feel that __6.__ has had a good influence on children because __7.__ offers educational programs for them. __8.__ people feel that television is bad for children. They feel that there are __9.__ programs about crime and violence, and that even educational programs don't help __10.__ education.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. entertainment：娛樂
2. possibilities：可能（行）之事
3. kinds of：種類
4. influence：影響
5. offers educational programs：提供教育節目
6. crime and violence：犯罪與暴力

questions.q: There are many ____ entertainment for children today--books, movies, games, and sports are only (2) the possibilities.
questions.zh: 現今對兒童而言有許多種娛樂——書本、電影、遊戲和運動僅是其中的一部分可能。
questions.explain:
① many ＋ 複數名詞；many a ＋ 單數名詞。
② kinds of ＝ sorts of ＝ types of（種類）。

questions.q: ...books, movies, games, and sports are only ____ the possibilities.
questions.zh: …書本、電影、遊戲和運動僅是諸多可能中的幾種。
questions.explain: a few of ＋ 可數名詞複數（一些…）；a little of ＋ 不可數名詞。因後有 the possibilities（可數名詞複數），故選 a few of。

questions.q: Television is ____ newest kinds of entertainment.
questions.zh: 電視是最新型的娛樂之一。
questions.explain:
① the newest（最新的，最高級前加 the）。
② one of the ＋ 最高級 ＋ 複數名詞（最…的…之一）。

questions.q: It ____ for about forty years...
questions.zh: 它已經存在了大約四十年…
questions.explain: 表示持續「一段時間」（for about forty years），應用現在完成式 has existed（已經存在有…年了）。

questions.q: ...and ____ a great influence on children.
questions.zh: …並且對兒童產生了重大的影響。
questions.explain:
① have a great influence on（對…有重大影響）。
② 本題強調動詞一致性的觀念：主詞為 It，It has existed ... and has had ...。

questions.q: Some people feel that ____ has had a good influence on children...
questions.zh: 有些人覺得電視對兒童有良好的影響…
questions.explain:
① television ＝ TV（電視），當總稱時為不可數名詞，不加 s。
② TV sets（電視機），為具體可數名詞。

questions.q: ...because ____ offers educational programs for them.
questions.zh: …因為它為他們提供教育性的節目。
questions.explain: 因 television 為不可數名詞，視為單數概念，應用代名詞 it 來代替。

questions.q: ____ people feel that television is bad for children.
questions.zh: 其他的人則覺得電視對兒童有害。
questions.explain: Some people ＋ V.... Other people（或 Others）＋ V...（有些人…，其他人…）。後有名詞 people，故用形容詞 Other 修飾。

questions.q: They feel that there are ____ programs about crime and violence...
questions.zh: 他們覺得有太多關於犯罪與暴力的節目…
questions.explain: programs（節目）為可數名詞複數，應用 many 修飾，故選 too many。

questions.q: ...and that even educational programs don't help ____ education.
questions.zh: …而且甚至連教育節目也對孩子的教育沒有幫助。
questions.explain: 所有格 ＋ 名詞。本題可用 a child's education 或 children's education。選項中只有 (C) a child's 正確。
